desc: The FAST FTC 4X is the first integrated magnifier available on the market, bringing the magnifier up to a 2.26″ optical centerline from the rail. Integrating the mount with the optic shaves weight, increases strength and ensures streamlined functionality with near-zero occlusion of the primary optic when stowed. The optical glass provides a clear and durable sighting solution while UNITY’s FTC (flip-to-center) technology allows for easy stowage when not in use.
